tei:div.tei:p: (stod cha/)

gleng brjod/ dpar skrun gsal bshad/ gur dang po/ bka' babs byin brgyud/ 004) ring brgyud bka' bzhi+i bla ma'i rnam thar/ 1 chos rgyal iṇ+ḍa bo Zི/ 2 rgyal po bī su kalpa/ 3 grub brgya dpon ma taṃ gi 6 slob dpon ku ku ri pa/ 7 slob dpon tsa4 pa/ 8 slon dpon ḍoṃ £ི pa/ 9 slob dpon £ི na pa badz+ra/ 10 slob dpon C ba pa/ 11

slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ 12 ḍā ki ma skal pa bzang mo/ 13 lha bu blo gros rin chen/ 14 ri khrod dbang phyug shwa ba ri pa/ 15 slob dpon lū i pa/ 16 slob dpon ḍeṃ gi pa/ 17 ḍā ki ma kun tu bzang mo/ 18 dpal sa ra ha pa dang ZÉ ri ka pa'i rnam mgur/ 19 sa ra has mai tri pa la gdams pa'i rnam mgur/ 20 dpal shā ba ri pas mai tri pa rjes su bzung tshul/ 21 mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i rnam thar/ gnyis pa/ rnam thar dang gsung mgur/ nye brgyud bka' bzhi+i bla ma'i rnam thar/ 005) dpal tai lo pa'i rnam thar dang gsung mgur/

tai lo shes rab bzang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus tshigs bcad ma/sgyu ma mkhan brtul ba/ chang 'tshong ma la gdams pa/ rngon pa dzhi na la gdams/ mu stegs ston pa man tri la gdams pa/ las rgyu 'bras kyi don bstan pa/ mthu mkhan la gdams pa/ glu mkhan dbyangs mkhan la gdams pa/ nus ldan zil gyis mnan pa'i yon tan/ mu stegs pa btul ba'i yon tan/ shan pa btul ba'i yon tan/ glu mkhan btul ba'i yon tan/ mthu bo che btul ba'i yon tan/ nus ldan btul ba'i yon tan/

bde mchog 'khor lor sprul pa'i yon tan/ bde mchog 'khor lo dngos su bstan pa'i yon tan/ 006) dpal nā ro pa'i rnam thar dang mgur/ 1 phyi lung bstan 'tshol dus kyi dka' ba la brten nas snod ldan ngos bzung ba dka' phran dang po/ dka' phran gnyis pa/ dka' phran gsum pa/ dka' phran bzhi ba/ dka' phran lnga ba/ dka' phran drug pa/ dka' phran bdun pa/ dka' phran brgyad pa/

dka' phran dgu ba/ dka' phran bcu ba/ dka' phran bcu gcig dka' phran bcu gnyis/ 2 nang sdug bsngal nyams len gyi dka' ba la brten nas brda'i don 'grol ba/ dka' chen dang bo/ dka' chen gnyis pa/ dka' chen gsum pa/ dka' chen bzhi ba/ dka' chen lnga ba/ dka' chen drug pa/

dka' chen bdun pa/ dka' chen brgyad pa/ dka' chen dgu ba/ dka' chen bcu ba/ dka' chen bcu gcig dka' chen bcu gnyis/ ba mchog brgyad kyi mgur/ 8 nyon mongs ye shes su bsgyur ba'i mgur/ 9 dbang gi brda don bkrol ba'i mgur/ 10 rig ma skad cig la dbang bzhi tshang tshul gyi mgur/ 11 dbang bzhi rtogs pa'i mgur/ 12 skal ldan gdul bya lung bstan pa'i mgur/

13 rje mar pa'i gdeng tshod drug gi mgur/ 007) rdo rje 'chang tai lo pa dang nā ro ye shes dngos grub kyi rnam mgur/ 008) sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā'i rnam thar chen mo mthong ba don yod/ 1 sku skye ba bzhes nas dam pa'i chos dang mjal tshul/ 3 nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs tshul/ 4 rgya gar du thengs gnyis pa byon tshul/ 5 rgya gar du thengs gsum pa byon tshul/ 6 sras dar ma mdo sku gshegs tshul/ 7 bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i lung bstan mdzad tshul/ 8 sku'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bkod pa bstan tshul/ 9 gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul/ 009) mar pa lo tsā'i rnam mgur/ 1 sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsās bla ma la rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur/ 2

rgya gar du phar 'byon gyi mgur/ 3 lta ba thugs la 'khrungs tshul gyi mgur/ 4 gnyos la khrel 'debs kyi mgur/ 5 bkra shis byon skyems su phul ba'i mgur/ 6 bla ma pen ta ba zhus lan gyi mgur/ 7 do ha rdo rje'i mgur/ 8 ngo mtshar che rgu'i mgur/ 11 jo sras mdo sde la 'pho ba gdab pa'i mgur/ 12 la stod khum bu'i mgur/ 13 blo bde bcu gsum gyi mgur/ 14 the tshom mun sel gyi mgur/ 15 ka bzhi'i lung bstan gyi mgur/ 16 tshogs 'khor nam byed kyi mgur/ 17 chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur/ 18

rtogs pa klong gyur gyi mgur/ 19 mes ston la ched du gtad pa'i mgur/ 20 yongs su grags pa'i lam glu ring mo/ 21 nā ro dang mai tri pa'i bzhed gzhung gi rtogs mgur phul ba/ 22 bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mgur/

gsum pa/ dbang gi chos skor/ 010) bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ 011) dbang bzhi nyams phyag rgya chen po/ 012) dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus tshigs bcad can/ 013) dbang rgyud kyi gdams pa dpal he ru ka'i smin byed/ 014) rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i me dbang gi cho ga 015) dbang dang 'brel ba rgyud kyi gdams pa 'od gsal nyi zla kha sbyor gyi zhal gdams/ 016) dbang bdud 'grol gyi gdams pa dang brda yi sgo nas gnyug ma'i don bstan pa/ 1 dbang bzhi'i don bstan pa/ 2 brda yi sgo nas gnyug ma'i don bstan pa/ 017) dbang gi phyag len kha skong bstan pa/ bzhi ba/ dpal bde mchog gi chos skor/ 018) dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lo rgyus/ 1 gdul bya'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi ji ltar yin skor/ 2

'dul byed he ru ka byon tshul/ 3 tshul ji lta bus btul tshul/ 019) yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lo rgyus/ 020) dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga 021) yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 022) dpal bde mchog gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ 023) dpal lhan cig skyes pa bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ 024) bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 025) bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 026) bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ 027) dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag 028) blon po rigs gsum las byed dang dmangs 'phrin las mthun sbyor/ 029) bde mchog gsang ba rin po che'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bsdus don/ 030) dbang dang 'brel ba rgyud kyi gdams pa bde mchog gsang ba rin po che/

031) bde mchog gsang ba rin po che yid bzhin nor bu'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ 032)rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba/ 033)rdo rje phag mo'i lhan cig skyes ma'i sgom bzlas/ 034) rang byin gyis brlab pa'i gdams pa lhan cig skyes ma'i sgrub thabs thabs shes 'brel/ 035) dpal mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs/ lnga ba/ phyag rgya chen po/ 036) phyag rgya chen po gaṅga ma/ 037) dpal tai lo pa'i gzer drug nag po dge ba la gdams pa/ 1 skyabs 'gro byin rlabs kyi gzer/ 2 srog rtsol gnad kyi gzer/ 3 gnyug ma ngo sprod kyi gzer/ 4 nyams myong rtags kyi gzer/ 5 'pho ba gnad kyi gzer/ 6 'chi kha ye shes kyi gzer/ 038)

mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i phyag chen gser gyi phreng ba/ 1 byin rlabs shugs 'byung gi le'u/ 2 sgom don nyams kyi le'u/ 3 ye shes rang gsal gyi le'u/ 050) mai tri ba'i man ngag zab mo lam dgu phrugs/1 gtum mo la bslab par gsum/ 2 phyag rgya la bslab par gsum/ 3 kun gzhi la bslab par gsum/ 051) lta ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 052) phyag rgya chen po/ 053) thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig brgyad pa/ 054) rgyud kun gyi bcud bsdus bar do ngo sprod lam bde chen blo phyag chen bzhag pa'i man ngag 055) rgyud bla ma'i tshig don rnam par 'grel pa/ 1

snying po'i skabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ 2 byang chub skabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ 3 yon tan skabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ 4 phrin las skabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ 5 phan yon skabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ drug pa/ nā ro chos drug 057) chos drug gi rtsa ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsung bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma/ 058) sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i thugs kyi nying khu nā ro chos drug sras mkhar ma/ 072) chos drug ka dpe/ 1 gtum mo'i ka dpe/ 2 rim gyis dang cig car gyi khyad par/ 3

sgom du med pa'i man ngag 4 rmi lam ka dpe/ 5 'od gsal ka dpe/ 6 'pho ba'i ka dpe/ 7 grong 'jug ka dpe/ 8 bar do'i ka dpe/ 9 bar do lam du byed pa/ 10 gdams ngag gnad kyi ka dpe/ 11 sgom du med pa'i man ngag 059)

zab lam snying po nā ro'i chos drug gsang ba bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 060) thun mong gi zhal gdams chos drug gi nyams len du dril ba/ 061) slob mar byin rlabs 'pho ba/ 062) steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i gdams pa/ 1 gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs rtsa dbu ma'i 'khor lo skor ba/ 2 lam dngos po'i gnas thabs srog dang rtsol ba'i 'khor lo skor ba/ 3 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa byang sems bde ba'i 'khor lo skor ba/ 4 steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i bsdus don/ 063) gtum mo/ 064) gtum mo a thung*/ 065) sgyu lus kyi man ngag 066) rmi lam/ 067) rmi lam lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa/

068) gnyid 'od gsal/ 069) 'pho ba'i man ngag 1 rtsol ba'i 'pho na 'di lta ste/ 2 sbyangs te 'pho ba/ 3 btsan thabs su 'pho tshul/ 4 de kho na nyid kyi 'pho ba ni/ 070) sems grong du 'jug pa'i man ngag 1 'pho ba dang grong 'jug 2 grong 'jug gi man ngag 3 rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor ba/

071) rnam shes bar dor sbyangs tshul/ 073) 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa lī la bslab pa zab mo/ 074) bka' bzhi lo rgyus dang bcas pa bsre 'pho lag len du dril ba/ 075) bsre ba'i man ngag skor gsum/ 076) bsre ba'i gdams ngag sgom tshul bco brgyad/ 1 bsre ba'i gdams ngag ma drug 2 bsre ba'i gdams ngag bu bco brgyad/ 077) bsre ba'i man ngag 078) 'od gsal don bzhi ma/ 079) bar do'i rnam gzhag dang nyams len/ 080) chos drug gi man ngag ces bya ba/ 081)

rtsa rlung de kho na'i rnal 'byor dra ba'i 'khor lo bdud rtsi 'od zer can/ 082) rje mar pa'i zab rlung skor gsum/ 083) man ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ 085) mchog gi gtum mo sbar ba'i man ngag 086) ra sa ya nā'i bcud len/

bar cha/ bdun pa/ snyan brgyud kyi chos skor/ 048) dpal tai lo pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa/ 024) snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i pra khrid lung bstan tai lo'i gsung*/ 087) lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi rtsa ba/ 088) lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu'i gzhung las mar pas gdan drangs pa lnga/ 089) lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu las mar pas gdan drangs pa'i gzhung snga ma lnga'i rnam bshad/ 1 ye shes mkha' 'gro la shis pa brjod pa/ 2 brda don ngos bzung ba bstan pa/ 3 mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i 'char tshul/ 4 smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud bshig tshul/ 5 dam tshig rang sems me long blta ba/ 6 dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'de ba/ 090)

snyan brgyud las bde mchog zab pa lhan skyes/ 022) snyan brgyud gsang ba'i man ngag mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung*/ 023) snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu las yab bka' 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ 025) snyan brgyud yab bka'i bum dbang gi dkyil chog rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me/ 084) bde mchog snyan brgyud las rtsa ba drug yan lag so dgu gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad/ 1 bde chen rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor rnam drug 2 yan lag 'khrul 'khor so dgu 3 gtum mo'i 'phrul 'khor bco brgyad/ 026) snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mchog dbang gsum dngos su bskur ba'i lag len/ 027) snyan brgyud gdams pa rdo rje tshig gi mdud 'grol/ 037) dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud gsang ba'i man ngag 038) dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud gsang ba'i man ngag gi mchan 'grel/ 031) snyan brgyud bde mchog lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ 044)snyan brgyud las bde mchog rgya che ba'i lhan skyes sgrub thabs/

091) dpal lhan cig skyes ma'i mngon rtogs rgyal mo chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i gdams pa/ 092) yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje'i shog dril/ 093) yi dam rdo rje phag mo'i shog dril/ 094) bde mchog dmangs 'phrin las 'thun sbyor gyi shog dril/ 095) mar pa lo tsā'i khyad par gyi gdams pa snyan gyi shog dril bzhi'i lo rgyus/ 096) mar pa lo tsā'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ rtsa rlung dra mi 1 lta ba gtan la 'beb pa gzhi yi bar do/ 2 sgom pas nyams su len pa lam gyi bar do/ 102) mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā'i snyan gyi shog dril las phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus rtsa tshig 103) mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā'i snyan gyi shog dril las phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus mchan 'grel/ 104) phyag rgya chen po'i tshig bsdus 'grel pa/ 056) snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ 105) rlung gi zhal gdams/ 106)

dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rnam gsum/ 107) spros med ting 'dzin dbang gi shog dril/ 108) 'dod chags rdo rje'i shog dril/ 109) ser sna rdo rje shog dril/ 110) gti mug rdo rje'i shog dril/ 111) nga rgyal rdo rje'i shog dril/ 112) phrag dog rdo rje kun bkur sde/ 113) zhal gdams shog dril/ 114) las kyi rdo rje'i shog dril/ 115) sgyu lus kyi man ngag skor rdo rje'i shog dril/ 116) sgyu 'phrul rdo rje grong 'jug gi shog dril/ 117) gnod sbyin khul po dar thod can gyi shog dril/ 118) rgyal po chos nyid rang grol gyi shog dril/ 119)

£ ga rdo rje'i shog dril/ brgyad pa/ gegs sel gyi chos skor/ 120) gegs sel yid bzhin nor bu gsal byed snying po zhes bya ba/ 1 rlung zug ye shes su ro mnyam pa/ 2 rtsa zug ye shes su ro mnyam pa/ 3 thig le'i zug ye shes su ro mnyam pa/ 4 'byung lnga'i rlung cha ma snyom pa ye shes su ro mnyam pa/ 5 rtsa rlung sems gsum ye shes su ro mnyam pa/ 221) rlung gi de nyid bdun cu/ 1 phyi rlung lus la rengs pa'i skyon sel thabs/ 2 gsang rlung srog dang sdong pa'i skyon sel thabs/ 3

nang rlung snying khar rengs pa'i skyon sel thabs/ 4 srog 'dzin rlung gi de nyid bdun bstan pa/ 5 me mnyam rlung gi de nyid bdun bstan pa/ 6 thur sel rlung gi de nyid bdun bstan pa/ 7 gyen rgyu'i rlung gi de nyid bdun bstan pa/ 8 khyab byed rlung gi de nyid bdun bstan pa/ 9 gzugs kyi rtog pa sad pa 'khor lo'i rlung gi de nyid bstan pa/ 10 sgra'i rtog pa sad pa 'khor lo'i rlung gi de nyid bdun/ 11 dri'i rtog pa sad pa 'khor lo'i rlung gi de nyid bdun/ 12 ro'i rtog pa sad pa 'khor lo'i rlung gi de nyid bdun/

13 reg bya'i rtog pa sad pa 'khor lo'i rlung 'di de nyid bdun/ 14 rtsa lam sbyang tshul/ 15 thig le'i zug dang skyon sel tshul/ 16 'byung lnga'i rlung cha ma snyom pa'i skyon sel tshul/ 17 rtsa yig 'bru rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa ro snyom tshul/ 229) 'byung bzhi ro snyoms/ 230) na tsha bogs dbyung ba'i gzer/ 231) 'chi ba grogs su 'khyer ba'i gzer/ 232) nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i gzer la/ 233) rnam rtog rang sar grol ba'i gzer/

234) bar chad g.yang du blan pa'i gzer/ dgu ba/ rgyud 'grel gyi chos skor/ 240) dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim lnga/ 1 gzhi yi gnas lugs/ 2 'khor bar 'khrul lugs/ 3 rnam dag sbyang gzhi/ 4 lam rim lnga/ 5 'bras bu thob tshul/ 241) gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gdams ngag 242) rim lnga'i bsdus gsal/ 243)rgyud sde gcig dril gyi zhus lan/ 046) brda bstan rdo rje tshig rkang gi gdams pa/ 235) dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po kye'i rdo rje'i brtag gnyis pa'i khrid yig 'bum chung nyi ma/brtag pa dang po/

1 rdo rje'i rigs kyi le'u/ gleng gzhi mdor bstan/ ma rgyud bshad pa/ rgyud phyung tshul bshad pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i gleng gzhi/ rgyud byung tshul bshad pa/ mtshan don snying bsdus dang 'gyur phyag mtshan don gzhi la sbyar ba/ mtshan don lam la sbyar ba/ mtshan don 'bras bu la sbyar ba/ mtshan don rgyas bshad thun mong la bslab pa/

mtshan don rgyas bshad thun min la bslab pa/ mjug sdom bshad pa/ gzhi dbang dang sbyar ba/ gzhi bskyed rim dang sbyar ba/ gzhi rdzogs rim dang sbyar ba/ lam la sbyar ba/ 'bras bu la sbyar ba/ rgyud don gleng bslang ba/ rgyud kyi mtshan bshad pa/

rgyud don bskyed rdzogs 'bras gsum la sbyar ba/ rgyud dngos bshad pa/ de la lha mo bco lnga'i rdzogs rim mdor bstan pa/ mjug sdom bshad pa/ rdzogs rim rgyas bshad shes bya'i yul du bstan pa/ lus dngos po'i gnas thabs bstan pa/ rtsa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa/ lus sems gnyis bsdom pa sems kyi rgyal por tshang ba/ rdzogs rim rgyas bshad rang lus la tshang ba bstan pa/ 2 sngags kyi le'u/ dkyil chog gi sngags tshan/

las tshogs kyi sngags/ ḍā ki ma bdun gyi las bdun bsgrub pa/ 3 lha'i le'u/ thun mong gi chings/ bsdus pa phyag gnyis pa'i bskyed chog 'bring po phyag bzhi pa'i bskyed chog rgyas pa phyag drug pa'i bskyed chog bsdus pa phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs/ 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad bskyed pa/ 'bring po phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs/

rgyas pa phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs/ 4 dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ lha dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 5 de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ ye shes de kho na nyid/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid/ lha'i de kho na nyid la/ bdag gi de kho na nyid/ de kho na nyid bzhi la gdams pa/
le'u'i mtshan/ 7 ts+tsho

´É'i le'u/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ brda'i dgos pa/ brda'i dbye ba/ brda'i gnas/ brda'i dus/ tshogs kyi yo byad 'du ba/ he ru ka gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ rdo rje thod sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ le'u'i mtshan/ 8 rnal 'byor ma'i le'u/

bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gzhung la chos gsum/ bskyed rim sgom pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi mtshams sbyor/ bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag rdzogs rim rgyas bshad/ las rgya'i lhan skyes sgom pa/ dga' bzhi'i gnas lugs bstan pa/ dga' bzhi'i mtshan nyid/

rtog med lhan skyes blang byar bstan pa/ phyag chen bla ma'i dus mthas rtogs par bstan pa/ phyag chen gyi gzhag thabs bstan pa/ rtogs pa'i che ba bstan pa/ bsod nams chung bas kyang 'grub par bstan pa/ phyag chen dang mi 'bral bar byed pa/ srid pa lugs 'byung lugs bzlog bstan pa/ snang ba grogs su 'char ba bstan pa/ rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa la/ sgom pa la gdams pa/

le'u'i mtshan/ 9 rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ mdor bstan pa/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa mdor bstan/ kun rdzob lha so so'i dag pa mdor bstan/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa'i rgyas bshad/ kun rdzob lha so so'i dag pa rgyas bshad/ kun rdzob lha so so'i mjug bsdus pa/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi mjug bsdus pa/

le'u yi mtshan/ 10 dbang bskur bya ba'i le'u/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ le'u'i gzhung la don tshan gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bri tshul mdor bstan/ dbang bskur mdor bstan/ dkyil chog dang dbang bzhi pa/ le'u'i mtshan/ 11 mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u/ sgrol ma'i dbang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs/ lta stangs/

rlung*/ nyams sad pa'i gnas/ dus kyi bsnyen pa/ lta stangs bzhi po sgrub pa'i dgos pa/ bza' ba'i dam tshig skye ba bdun pa'i sha bsten pa/ rgyud kyi don du bsdu ba/ le'u yi mtshan/ brtag pa gnyis pa/ 1 rab gnas kyi le'u/ rab gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ rab gnas kyi phan yon/

rab gnas ji ltar bya ba'i dris lan/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ phyi yi mchod pa/ thab kyi mtshan nyid/ sa blang ba/ me lha gshegs gsol gyi sngags/ mchod pa'i sngags/ le'u yi mtshan/ 2 dngos grub kyi le'u/ bskyed rdzogs kyi dngos grub/

lan rgyas bshad/ rigs kyi dbye ba mdor bstan/ rigs kyi dbye ba rgyas bshad/ rigs kyi dbye bsdu/ le'u yi mtshan/ 3 dgongs pa'i skad kyi le'u/ mtshams sbyor/ lus sems sdom pa'i rnam gzhag mdor bstan/ lus sems sdom pa rgyas bshad/ le'u'i mtshan/ 4 phyag rgya bsdus pa'i le'u/

le'u yi gzhung*/ mtshams sbyor sngon 'gro'i gsol 'debs/ glu gar gyi the tshom dris pa/ bshad bya dngos/ lha mo bco lnga'i sa bon bshad pa/ rtsa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ byang sems mi spong bar bstan pa/ lus mchog gsum gtan la dbab pa/ lus gdod nas sprul skur gtan la dbab pa/ lha mo brgyad kyi rgya 'chol ba'i skyon spang ba/

gtor ma'i sngags kyi las tshogs/ lha mo gsum gyi rgyas 'debs pa/ rigs bdag gi dbye bsdu bstan pa/ mjug sdud rnam dag bshad pa/ le'u yi mtshan/ 5 mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/ le'u yi gzhung*/ rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa/ 'bras bu he ru ka bskyed pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags dris pa/ rtsa sngags kyi lan/
